unit: per kg (carcase or live weight) or per head
note: Meat & Livestock Australia NLRS saleyard indicators: weighted average auction prices for the trading day, in Australian dollars (converted from MLA's cents per kg); n is the number of animals sold. MLA publishes some indicators a day or two late; their newest trading day is kept: Eastern Young Cattle (2026-10-21), National Restocker Yearling Steer (2026-10-22), National Feeder Steer (2026-10-22), National Heavy Steer (2026-10-22), National Light Lamb (2026-10-22), National Trade Lamb (2026-10-22), National Heavy Lamb (2026-10-22), National Merino Lamb (2026-10-22), National Restocker Lamb (2026-10-22), National Mutton (2026-10-22), National Restocker Yearling Heifer (2026-10-22), National Processor Cow (2026-10-22), Online Lamb (2026-10-22), National Feeder Heifer (2026-10-22).
